about.experience: Agro Vit Food Export - 8 Years of Excellence
about.mainTitle: Wide range of frozen fruits and vegetables using IQF technology
about.description1: Agro Vit Food is an Egyptian company specialized in exporting various types of frozen fruits and vegetables using IQF (Individually Quick Frozen) technology, ensuring the highest quality standards and versatile packaging options to meet diverse market needs.
about.description2: With over 8 years of experience in both Egyptian and international markets, we have been committed since our inception to international food safety and quality standards, enabling us to build strong and reliable business partnerships with clients worldwide.
about.description3: Thanks to Egypt's ideal climate and fertile soil irrigated by the Nile River, we take pride in offering products with a unique natural flavor and exceptional quality that is second to none.

brand.subtitle: Our Brand
brand.title: From the Finest Egyptian Produce
brand.p1: We provide our clients with a wide range of frozen products under our private brand 'Agro Vit Food', which has earned the trust of importers in international markets thanks to its superior quality and reliability.
brand.p2: We also offer Private Label packaging services with various container sizes suitable for all wholesale, retail, and industrial sectors (from 400g bags up to 10kg cartons).
list: Flexible packaging to suit all B2B commercial requests
Harvesting at the beginning of the season for best price and quality
Mechanical automated cutting for hygiene and size consistency

mission.title: Mission
mission.desc: To provide the highest quality of frozen fruits and vegetables using the latest freezing technologies at competitive prices to our clients in various global markets.

vision.title: Vision
vision.desc: To be a market leader in the export of frozen fruits and vegetables locally and globally through continuous development and investment in personnel and facilities.

markets.title: Our Markets
markets.desc: We export our products to many countries worldwide, including Russia, Poland, and the USA, with constant aspirations to expand into European and Asian markets.

goal.title: Our Goal
goal.desc: Continuous expansion of our product range by adding unique varieties that meet our clients' requirements while ensuring the constant development of quality.

farming.title: Farming
farming.desc: We select the best varieties and seeds, monitoring crops from start to harvest at peak ripeness, focusing on natural fertilizers.

sorting.title: Selection & Sorting
sorting.desc: We carefully supervise the picking process to ensure the most ripe fruits are chosen, followed by washing and sorting to remove impurities.

cooling.title: Pre-Cooling
cooling.desc: Products are cooled in preparation for the rapid freezing process, reaching -18°C while removing excess moisture for quality.

iqf.title: IQF Rapid Freezing
iqf.desc: We use the latest IQF technologies where products are quickly frozen to the core at -40°C, preserving flavor, texture, and nutrition.

packaging.title: Packaging & Storage
packaging.desc: We offer wholesale and retail packaging in various sizes, with secure storage in temperature-controlled warehouses.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.desc: We deliver our products anywhere in the world on time, maintaining the cold chain throughout the shipping journey.

cta.title: Would you like to cooperate with us?
cta.desc: Contact us today to learn more about our products and services
